metadata.description: Dolle developer toolkit — command-gated skill packs, agents, and hooks for AI-assisted development.

plugins.name: devkit
plugins.description: Command-gated skill packs for subagent-driven development, LangChain agents, LangGraph workflows, documentation, UI/UX design (via the bundled Dolle-MCP server), web performance, UI design fundamentals, prompt enhancement (clarify with AskUserQuestion, then sharpen), and shipping to platforms — Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (CI/CD & IaC). Packs load only when you call their command, keeping startup context minimal.
